## Overview

This is a synthesis of Kestrel logger data for the DEAD project. Loggers were deployed in March 2021 and collected in end of October or early November 2022. Prior R script in this project combines and synthesizes data starting with the first logger downloads. Summary plots for microsites and sites are plotted.

This code pulls data from the Dropbox folder using a config.yml file that maps to the Dropbox folder ("\~/DeAD NSF MSB Dryland Decomposition/Field&LabCircle/DEAD1_0/logger_data"). Data are written the same way.

Written July 24, 2023 updated 2023-07-25, 2025-01-30, 2026-01-21\
Heather Throop

```{r}
#|label: Load-packages
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(reshape2)
library(hms)

sessionInfo()
```

```{r}
# Use the stored config file to define the path for the DeAD Dropbox folder
DEADloggers <- config::get()
```

# Data Read

## List Kestrel Files for Reading In

*This pulls the L2 csv file from Dropbox.*

```{r}
#|label: Read-and-clean-L2-data

# read in the combined L2 dataset (all sites, all times, all microsites)
L2_cleaning = read.csv(file = file.path(DEADloggers,  "DEAD_Kestrel_L2.csv"))

# check the loggers that we have (there should be 51)
L2_cleaning |>
  group_by(site, loggerID) |>
  summarize(n=n())

# Data clean-up 
# remove the extra columns that gets added in (columns "X" and "...1")
L2_clean <- L2_cleaning[, -c(1)]

# check data types
L2_clean <- L2_clean |>
  mutate(
    loggerID = as.factor(loggerID),
    date = as.Date(datetime), 
    HMS = format(datetime, format = "%H:%M:%S"))

# Put datetime data into POSIXct
L2_clean <- L2_clean |>
  mutate(
    datetime = if_else(nchar(datetime) == 10,
                       paste(datetime, "00:00:00"),
                       datetime),
    datetime = ymd_hms(datetime, tz = "UTC")
  )
```

# Site x Microsite Means

```{r}
#| label: hourly site-x-microsite-means
# create df that condenses the multiple loggers per site x microsite condition down to one mean value per hour

KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df <- L2_clean |>
  group_by(site, microsite, datetime) |>
  summarize(
               N    = sum(!is.na(RH)),
               mean_T = mean(temperature, na.rm=TRUE),
               sd_T   = sd(temperature, na.rm=TRUE),
               se_T   = sd_T / sqrt(N),
               mean_RH = mean(RH, na.rm=TRUE),
               sd_RH   = sd(RH, na.rm=TRUE),
               se_RH   = sd_RH / sqrt(N)
               ) |>
  na.omit(KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df)

```

```{r}
#| label: daily-site-microsite means
# create df that condenses the multiple loggers per site x microsite condition down to one mean value day

KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df$date <- as.Date(KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df$datetime) # extract the date out of the datetime stamp

KestrelL2_dailymeans_df <- KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df |>
  group_by(site, microsite, date) |>
  summarize(
              N    = sum(!is.na(mean_RH)),
              dailyT = mean(mean_T, na.rm=TRUE),
              sd_dailyT   = sd(mean_T, na.rm=TRUE),
              se_dailyT   = sd_dailyT / sqrt(N),
              dailyRH = mean(mean_RH, na.rm=TRUE),
              sd_dailyRH   = sd(mean_RH, na.rm=TRUE),
              se_dailyRH   = sd_dailyRH / sqrt(N),
              dailyminRH = min(mean_RH, na.rm=TRUE),
              dailymaxRH = max(mean_RH, na.rm=TRUE),
              daily_max_T = max(mean_T, na.rm=TRUE),
              daily_min_T = min(mean_T, na.rm=TRUE)
              )
```

## daily mean plots

```{r}
# create runs to group together consecutive days of data for plotting lines between points. Any gap of more than 3 days will start a new run.
daily_runs <- KestrelL2_dailymeans_df |>
  arrange(site, microsite, date) |>
  group_by(site, microsite) |>
  mutate(run = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(date) > 3))) |>   # new run after any gap > 3 day
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(grp = interaction(site, microsite, run))
```


```{r}
#| label: daily mean RH

p2 <- ggplot(daily_runs, aes(x = date, y = dailyRH,
                             color = microsite, group = grp)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Open = "#A6611A", Shrub = "#018571")) +
  ylab("Daily Mean Relative Humidity (%)") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_x_datetime(limits = as.POSIXct(c("2021-03-01", "2022-11-01"), tz = "UTC"),
                 date_breaks = "1 month",
                 date_labels = "%b %Y",
                 expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_grid(site ~ .) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.18, 0.99),
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      legend.background = element_blank())
p2

ggsave(file = file.path(DEADloggers, "figures", "daily_mean_RH.jpg"), 
       plot = p2, width = 6, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```

# Microsite Comparisons

## hourly comparisons - T and RH

```{r}
# read in the combined L2 dataset (all sites, all times, all microsites)

# plot T each hour by site, comparing microsites
p <- ggplot(KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df, aes(x=datetime, y=mean_T, color = microsite)) + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temperature (C)") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "2 week", labels = date_format("%b %d"))
p + facet_grid(site ~ .)

# plot RH each hour by site, comparing microsites
p <- ggplot(KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df, aes(x=datetime, y=mean_RH, color = microsite)) + geom_line() +
  labs(title = "") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("RH (%)") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "2 week", labels = date_format("%b %d"))
p + facet_grid(site ~ .)


```

## microsite differences

```{r}
#| label: microsite-differences-calculations

# convert from long to wide form to calculate differences between microsites at a given time
microsite_diff_df <- KestrelL2_hourlymeans_df %>% 
  select(site, microsite, datetime, mean_T,mean_RH) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=c(microsite), 
              values_from=c(mean_T, mean_RH)) 

microsite_diff_df$shrub.openT <- microsite_diff_df$mean_T_Shrub - microsite_diff_df$mean_T_Open  
microsite_diff_df$shrub.openRH <- microsite_diff_df$mean_RH_Shrub - microsite_diff_df$mean_RH_Open 
```

```{r}
#| label: microsite-differences-by-T

# plot shrub minus open T by site
# add interpolated points where the line crosses zero (within each site) so that color plots differently above and below zero
add_crossings_T <- function(d) {
  d <- d %>% arrange(datetime)
  x <- as.numeric(d$datetime)
  y <- d$shrub.openT
  i <- which(head(y, -1) * tail(y, -1) < 0)
  if (length(i) == 0) return(d)
  new <- d[i, ]
  new$datetime <- as.POSIXct(x[i] - y[i] * (x[i + 1] - x[i]) / (y[i + 1] - y[i]),
                             origin = "1970-01-01",
                             tz = attr(d$datetime, "tzone"))
  new$shrub.openT <- 0
  bind_rows(d, new) |> arrange(datetime)
}

seg_df <- microsite_diff_df |>
  group_by(site) |>
  group_modify(~ add_crossings_T(.x)) |>
  mutate(xend = lead(datetime),
         yend = lead(shrub.openT),
         sign = ifelse((shrub.openT + yend) < 0, "below", "above")) |>
  filter(!is.na(xend), !is.na(yend)) |>
  ungroup()

p6 <- ggplot(seg_df, aes(x = datetime, y = shrub.openT,
                        xend = xend, yend = yend, color = sign)) +
  geom_segment() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(above = "#018571", below = "#A6611A"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = expression
       ("Shrub Temperature - Open Temperature ("*degree*C*")")) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(site ~ .) +
  ggtitle("data are hourly means of multiple loggers")
p6

ggsave(file = file.path(DEADloggers, "figures", "T_micorsite_diff_by_time.jpg"), 
       plot = p6, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
#| label: microsite-differences-by-RH

# plot shrub minus open RH by site
p <- ggplot(microsite_diff_df, aes(x=datetime, y=shrub.openRH, group = 1)) + 
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Shrub RH (%) - Open RH (%)") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "2 week", labels = date_format("%b %d"))
p + facet_grid(site ~ .)

# plot shrub minus open RH by site
# add interpolated points where the line crosses zero (within each site) so that color plots differently above and below zero
add_crossings_RH <- function(d) {
  d <- d %>% arrange(datetime)
  x <- as.numeric(d$datetime)
  y <- d$shrub.openRH
  i <- which(head(y, -1) * tail(y, -1) < 0)
  if (length(i) == 0) return(d)
  new <- d[i, ]
  new$datetime <- as.POSIXct(x[i] - y[i] * (x[i + 1] - x[i]) / (y[i + 1] - y[i]),
                             origin = "1970-01-01",
                             tz = attr(d$datetime, "tzone"))
  new$shrub.openRH <- 0
  bind_rows(d, new) |> arrange(datetime)
}

seg_df <- microsite_diff_df |>
  group_by(site) |>
  group_modify(~ add_crossings_RH(.x)) |>
  mutate(xend = lead(datetime),
         yend = lead(shrub.openRH),
         sign = ifelse((shrub.openRH + yend) < 0, "below", "above")) |>
  filter(!is.na(xend), !is.na(yend)) |>
  ungroup()

p7 <- ggplot(seg_df, aes(x = datetime, y = shrub.openRH,
                        xend = xend, yend = yend, color = sign)) +
  geom_segment() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(above = "#018571", below = "#A6611A"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Shrub RH (%) - Open RH (%)") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-60, -30, 0, 30, 60), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(site ~ .) +
  ggtitle("data are hourly means of multiple loggers")
p7

ggsave(file = file.path(DEADloggers, "figures", "RH_micorsite_diff_by_time.jpg"), 
       plot = p7, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

## climate space scatterplots

```{r}
#| label: climate-space-RH

p8 <- ggplot(microsite_diff_df, aes(x=mean_T_Open, y=mean_T_Shrub)) + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "") +
  xlab(expression("Open Temperature ("*degree*C*")")) +
  ylab(expression("Shrub Temperature ("*degree*C*")")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  facet_grid(site ~ .) + 
  geom_abline(aes(slope = 1, intercept=0), color = "blue") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-20, 75), ylim = c(-20, 75)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("data are hourly means of multiple loggers")
p8

ggsave(file = file.path(DEADloggers, "figures", "T_shrub_vs_open.jpg"), 
       plot = p8, width = 6, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
